related.title: 資料庫交易與日誌
related.why: 狀態提交與交易輸出可互相銜接
related.whyEn: State commits and transactional output connect
related.transfer: 狀態提交與交易輸出可互相銜接
related.transferEn: State commits and transactional output connect
related.difference: 事件時間窗口不同於資料庫單次快照
related.differenceEn: Event-time windows differ from database snapshots
practice: 由「事件 schema」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「事件時間窗口不同於資料庫單次快照」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From event schema, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Event-time windows differ from database snapshots", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.

history.title: 事件與分區
history.text: 官方公開資料「Kafka 日誌與複製設計」提供架構脈絡；本課先由「事件 schema」及「分區鍵」建立邊界，再進入實驗判讀。這是原創教材的學習順序，不是宣稱技術發明年代。
history.textEn: The primary reference Kafka log and replication design supplies architectural context. These original lessons start with event schema and partition keys before experiments; this is a learning sequence, not an invention-date claim.
